verdict: REAL LAYOUT TRADE-OFF DISCOVERED: Because B.Cu sits 1.30 mm from In1.Cu across the 1.065 mm core, cutting 'LX cutout L2' [1.65..3.30 x 9.15..14.70] on In1.Cu saves only tiny LX-to-GND capacitance (284.5 -> 236.6 fF), while opening a +52.0 dB aperture to F.Cu LED column traces (CS2_10..12) AND raising hot-loop inductance (4.199 -> 4.435 nH). More importantly, VBAT_SENSE on In2.Cu crosses 0.21 mm directly above the B.Cu VREG_LX pour, picking up ~148 mV narrow switching spikes on the un-decoupled 50 kOhm divider -> firmware MUST average 8-16 ADC0 samples! Y1 (12 MHz crystal, 11.8 mm away) sees < 24 uV (completely immune).
